settings.label: Update notifications
settings.hint: notify when a newer enigma-cli is published

settings.label: Auto-sync on launch
settings.hint: refresh already-deployed skills/memory when launching a tool via enigma (e.g. enigma claude)

settings.label: Remote skill updates
settings.hint: fetch newer skills from the GitHub repo on install/update, without waiting for a package release

settings.label: Customized-skill updates
settings.hint: when a skill you edited is updated: overwrite (replace with the new version) or keep (preserve your local edits); enigma default: overwrite

settings.label: Full-screen TUI
settings.hint: clear the screen for a clean TUI view; off renders inline among existing output

settings.label: Parallel sub-agents
settings.hint: let agents split long tasks across sub-agents running in parallel; edits the memory file - restart your agent to apply

settings.label: Token-efficient output
settings.hint: compress prose replies (off|lite|full|ultra); on = full; edits the memory file - restart your agent to apply

settings.label: Minimal code (anti-overengineering)
settings.hint: prefer the laziest solution that works (off|lite|full|ultra); on = full; edits the memory file - restart your agent to apply

settings.label: Context compression MCP
settings.hint: deploy enigma's token-compression MCP server (enigma_compress/retrieve/stats) into managed agents; toggling applies immediately to already-deployed agents; off removes it; enigma default: off

settings.label: Auto-lint on edit
settings.hint: auto-fix edited files and surface only unfixable findings; on enable installs @enigmax/linter and wires a post-write hook (Claude + opencode); enigma default: off

title: Local dashboard
blurb: browser dashboard to manage enigma - accounts, skills, settings, system resources - and see its measured savings

settings.label: Local dashboard
settings.hint: manage enigma (accounts, skills, settings, resources) and see savings; open with 'enigma dashboard' at http://enigma; off | on-demand (runs only while open, no idle cost; default when enabled) | always (lightweight background daemon)

settings.label: Real tool-usage stats
settings.hint: let the dashboard read the agent's own session transcripts (Claude Code) for real token usage + prompt-cache savings; reads your own session logs; enigma default: off

settings.label: Live auto-refresh
settings.hint: the dashboard refreshes its data automatically while the tab is focused; off = refresh only with the button

settings.label: Claude Code proxy (experimental)
settings.hint: route `enigma claude` through a local loopback proxy that forwards to Anthropic and measures real token usage; never stores auth or message content; Claude Code only; enigma default: off

settings.label: Live usage windows
settings.hint: show the real usage %/reset Claude's UI shows by probing Anthropic with your local Claude Code login (no proxy needed); reads your OAuth token, never stores it, and uses a tiny bit of quota; needs real tool-usage stats on; Claude Code only; enigma default: off

title: Git & attribution
blurb: how the coding agent commits and attributes its work in git

settings.label: Commit subject emoji
settings.hint: leading gitmoji on commit subjects

settings.label: Claude commit attribution
settings.hint: let Claude Code commit as its own contributor (Co-Authored-By / PR footer); enigma default: off

settings.label: Claude feedback survey
settings.hint: let Claude Code show the 'How is Claude doing?' session quality survey; enigma default: off

settings.label: GitHub CLI telemetry
settings.hint: let gh send usage analytics to GitHub; enigma default: disabled (privacy; avoids a Windows window-flash bug)

title: Commit guard
blurb: what enigma's git commit guard blocks (user-wide default; per-repo .githooks/enigma-guard.json can override)

settings.label: Block committed secrets
settings.hint: API keys, tokens, and private-key / keystore files (.pem, .key, .p12, .pfx, .jks, id_rsa); applies to every repo with enigma's guard unless overridden per-repo

settings.label: Block .env files
settings.hint: allows .env.example / .sample / .template; applies to every repo with enigma's guard unless overridden per-repo

settings.label: Block dependency/cache dirs
settings.hint: node_modules, __pycache__, venv; applies to every repo with enigma's guard unless overridden per-repo

settings.label: Warn on generated dirs
settings.hint: dist, build, .next, coverage; applies to every repo with enigma's guard unless overridden per-repo

settings.label: Warn on log / OS junk files
settings.hint: .log, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db; applies to every repo with enigma's guard unless overridden per-repo

settings.label: Warn on files over 5 MB
settings.hint: oversized blobs; applies to every repo with enigma's guard unless overridden per-repo

settings.label: Extra blocked paths
settings.hint: additional glob patterns to block from commits (e.g. secrets/*.json, *.local.env)

settings.label: Excluded paths (allowlist)
settings.hint: glob patterns the guard never flags, even if risky (e.g. tests/fixtures/**)

settings.label: Custom secret patterns
settings.hint: extra regex sources treated as secrets (e.g. mycorp_[a-z0-9]{32})

title: Prompt secret guard
blurb: block credentials in chat prompts before they reach the agent (Claude Code, via the local proxy; opt-in)

settings.label: Prompt secret guard (experimental)
settings.hint: scan outgoing chat messages and block secrets (API keys, tokens) before they reach Claude; routes `enigma claude` through the local proxy; uses the same patterns as the commit guard, plus your custom secret patterns; Claude Code only; enigma default: off

settings.label: Prompt guard action
settings.hint: what to do on a hit: redact (strip the secret, keep the turn working) or reject (block the whole request); only applies when the prompt secret guard is on; enigma default: redact

title: Permissions
blurb: approval-prompt bypass (security trade-off; on by default)

settings.label: Permission bypass (default)
settings.hint: on: every install bypasses each agent's approval prompts unless opted out per-agent; off: never bypass by default

settings.label: Claude Code approval bypass
settings.hint: skip per-action approval prompts

settings.label: OpenAI Codex approval bypass
settings.hint: skip approval prompts (global ~/.codex only)

settings.label: OpenCode approval bypass
settings.hint: skip per-action approval prompts
